LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistMortarPayload.label: dual mortar payload amplifier module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistMortarPayload.descri: A fixed dual-mortar module that increases shell damage and explosion radius. Mounted effects show the current multipliers. Fits a side or top slot; uses 100 W. Installation and removal require 100 work; removal has the usual failure chance.
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistMortarSupport.label: dual mortar rapid-fire support module
LanguageData.MT_Module_SpecialistMortarSupport.descri: A fixed dual-mortar support module for faster firing cycles and nearby automatic loading. Mounted effects are shown for the active combat system. Fits a side or top slot; uses 100 W. Installation and removal require 100 work; removal has the usual failure chance.
